summary: First full E2E run of the TUACARIGUA.COM marketplace. Backend: 27/29 pytest pass. The 2 failures: a regex-injection 500 on q, and the brute-force lockout not working behind the ingress. Frontend: all requested flows pass. That covers home (featured excludes sold, recent, category cards), hero search to /buscar with params, all filters/sort/hide-sold/clear, detail gallery prev/next/thumbs, the WhatsApp href (wa.me/584245245770 with the /anuncio/{id} link), the sold notice with no WhatsApp button, 404 page, price formats ($ 120.000 / Bs. 14.500), admin login error/success, /admin/panel redirect without a token, create with a real photo upload (served at /api/files/...), edit, toggle featured/sold (stats update), tabs, delete with confirm, and logout. Mobile 390px has no horizontal overflow.

critical.issue: Brute-force lockout does not work. The identifier is request.client.host + email, but behind the k8s ingress the client host changes between requests (seen: 10.66.0.200 and 10.66.0.201). Attempts are split across keys, so the 6th wrong attempt still returned 401 instead of 429. Fix: key on the X-Forwarded-For first IP (or on email only).

Returns 500. q is passed to $regex without escaping, so special characters like ( [ * + ? crash the query. Fix: re.escape(q). Frontend side: the search page then stays on 'Cargando...' skeletons forever because it has no error state.

minor.issue: USD and Bs prices are compared as raw numbers. Example: with sort=price_desc, Bs. 14.500 lands between $ 18.000 and $ 9.800, and a price range filter mixes currencies. Consider sorting/filtering inside one currency, or only applying the price filter when a currency is selected.
Uploaded files are never marked is_deleted, so orphan files pile up in object storage.

CORS_ORIGINS='*' together with allow_credentials=True. This is acceptable for Bearer-header auth, but the playbook expects explicit origins. No httpOnly auth cookie is set: the token is stored in localStorage by design.
If the object-storage GET fails, the request returns an unhandled 500. It should return a clean 404/502.

ui_bugs.issue: No error state. When the API errors, results-count stays 'Cargando...' with skeleton cards forever.

issues: The dashboard renders briefly before the /auth/me redirect when there is no token. This is minor; a route guard that checks for the token first would be better.
/admin does not redirect to /admin/panel when a valid token already exists.

action_items: Escape the q regex in list_listings (re.escape) to stop the 500.
Fix the login lockout identifier so it uses X-Forwarded-For (first IP) or email only, so it works behind the ingress.
Add an error state to the Search page and the Home grids for when a listings fetch fails.
Optional: handle mixed-currency price sort/filter; set explicit CORS origins; mark files as deleted when a listing is deleted.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: the $regex built from user input is unescaped (500s and possible ReDoS).
server.py login: request.client.host is the ingress IP, not the real client.
server.py serve_file: an object-storage exception is unhandled and becomes a 500.
Seed is idempotent: the admin is created only if missing and its password is never overwritten. The bcrypt hash starts with $2b$. Good.

success_rate.frontend: 97% (all requested flows pass; only the error-state gap)
